## Open Data & Statistics (211)

- [Canadian Database of Geochemical Surveys (CDoGS)](https://geochem.nrcan.gc.ca/cdogs/content/main/home_en.htm) — Canada · Federal · Survey database · geochemistry, surveys, mineral-exploration, xls — Catalogue of 1,600+ regional geochemical surveys across Canada with standardized raw analytical data downloads as spreadsheets, KML maps and WMS, plus element search.
- [Canadian Geographical Names Database Search](https://geonames.nrcan.gc.ca/search-place-names/search) — Canada · Federal · Lookup tool · place names, geography, gazetteer, api — Query nearly 350,000 official Canadian place names by name, coordinates or area, with API access and downloadable datasets, maintained by NRCan.
- [Canadian Heritage — Grants and Contributions Search](https://search.open.canada.ca/grants?owner_org=pch) — Canada · Federal · Funding database · grants, funding, csv, arts — Search 138,000+ Canadian Heritage grant/contribution agreements by recipient, program, value, year and province; whole dataset also downloadable as CSV.
- [Census Program](https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/index-eng.cfm) — Canada · Federal · Census portal · census, demographics — Census profiles, maps, and reference materials
- [EODMS — Earth Observation Data Management System](https://eodms-sgdot.nrcan-rncan.gc.ca/index-en.html) — Canada · Federal · Imagery search · aerial photos, satellite imagery, historical, nrcan — Search and order from NRCan's archive of satellite imagery and the National Air Photo Library — over 3 million historical aerial photos of Canada dating to the 1920s, with footprints on a map.
- [GC API Store](https://api.canada.ca/en/homepage) — Canada · Federal · API catalogue · api, developers, open data, digital government — Discover and try Government of Canada APIs in one catalogue, with documentation and self-serve access for building apps on government data and services.

## Environment, Climate & Monitoring (80)

- [Canadian Climate Data Online](https://climate.weather.gc.ca/) — Canada · Federal · Climate data · climate, weather — Daily, monthly, and hourly historical climate observations from ECCC stations
- [Canadian Hydrographic Service — Tides & Water Levels Archive](https://www.tides.gc.ca/en/tides-and-water-levels-data-archive) — Canada · Federal · Monitoring data · coastal, great lakes, hydrography, tides — Historical, downloadable observed water-level data from 968 CHS gauges across Canada, plus real-time observations and predictions via the IWLS API, benchmarks, and Great Lakes monthly means since 1918.
- [Canadian Ice Service](https://ice-glaces.ec.gc.ca/) — Canada · Federal · Marine/ice map · ice, marine — Super niche and very cool ice charts and marine ice information
- [CHS — Tides, Currents and Water Levels](https://www.tides.gc.ca/en/tides-currents-and-water-levels) — Canada · Federal · Prediction tool · tides, water levels, marine, predictions — Canadian Hydrographic Service predictions, observations and forecasts of tides and water levels for over 700 stations across Canada.
- [ClimateData.ca](https://climatedata.ca/) — Canada · Federal · Climate tools · climate, projections — Downscaled climate projections, analysis tools, and scenario maps for Canada
- [DFO — Seafisheries Landings Dashboard](https://www.dfo-mpo.gc.ca/stats/commercial/sea-maritimes-eng.htm) — Canada · Federal · Dashboard · dfo, fisheries, landings, catch — Filter 1990–2024 commercial seafisheries landings by province, species and year on an interactive dashboard; download volume and value as CSV.
- [DFO — Shellfish Harvesting Map (SHELLI)](https://www.dfo-mpo.gc.ca/shellfish-mollusques/cssp-map-eng.htm) — Canada · Federal · Interactive map · shellfish, food-safety, closures, map — Daily-updated coastwide map of bivalve harvesting openings and contamination closures; check prohibition orders before digging clams, oysters, mussels or scallops.

- [Ontario — Well Records Search](https://www.ontario.ca/page/well-records) — Ontario · Provincial · Search database · groundwater, wells, water, ontario — Interactive map of every reported water well in Ontario from the Water Well Information System — click a well for its record, plus a companion map of active water-taking permits.
- [Ontario Provincial Stream Water Quality Monitoring Network (PWQMN)](https://data.ontario.ca/dataset/provincial-stream-water-quality-monitoring-network) — Ontario · Provincial · Water quality dataset · Ontario, water quality, streams, nutrients — Stream water quality monitoring data across Ontario rivers and streams. Parameters include nutrients (total and dissolved), metals, and chloride. CSV downloads available by year (2023, 2024). Spatial coordinates for all monitoring stations included.
- [Department of Environment, Energy and Climate Action — Water Well Records (OD0040)](https://data.princeedwardisland.ca/datasets/48e7e4de6ab84efaa610bd26d89eac55/explore) — PEI · Provincial · Open dataset · groundwater, wells, water, open-data — Records for wells drilled on PEI — location, construction details and groundwater level — downloadable as CSV/GeoJSON or queryable via ArcGIS API.
- [Department of Land and Environment — PEI Air Monitoring](https://air.princeedwardisland.ca/) — PEI · Provincial · Dashboard · air-quality, aqhi, dashboard, environment — Explore PEI ambient air-quality dashboards (AQHI, CAAQS) and download provincial air-quality reports from the monitoring network.
- [Department of Land and Environment — PEI Water Registry](https://water.princeedwardisland.ca/) — PEI · Provincial · Registry · water, groundwater, registry, maps — Search official Water Act dashboards and maps for groundwater levels, stream flow, water-use permits, well records, watershed report cards and water quality.
- [PEI Climate Hazard & Risk Information System (CHRIS)](https://chris.peiclimate.ca/) — PEI · Provincial · Map viewer · pei, coastal-flooding, storm-surge, erosion — Official PEI government/UPEI map portal for coastal erosion, coastal flooding scenarios (2020–2100), inland flooding projections and historical storm events like Fiona and Dorian.
- [Forêt ouverte](https://www.foretouverte.gouv.qc.ca/) — Quebec · Provincial · Interactive map · forest, forestry, gis, lidar — MRNF interactive map of Quebec's forest territory: ecoforestry maps, aerial/satellite imagery, lidar products, wildfire disturbances, protected areas; view, query, download, WMS into GIS.

## Telecommunications & Digital (23)
